data.prompt: A fantasy game interface button featuring weathered iron construction with deep cold-blue enamel inset and ornate gold beveling around the edges. The horizontal rectangular button displays "Вход" in large, engraved pale silver-gold medieval serif Cyrillic letters, centered within the dark enamel surface. Corner rivets and subtle scratches enhance the aged metal aesthetic, while a frosty inner glow and dramatic drop shadows create dimensional depth. The design channels grungy medieval fantasy gaming with hand-painted textures and realistic material wear, evoking classic strategy game interfaces.
